q: The Doppler effect or Doppler shift is the change in ____ of a wave related to an observer due to the relative motion between the source and observer.
e: Doppler shift is the change in observed frequency when source and observer move relative to each other. Approach raises frequency; recession lowers it. Loudness and amplitude are a different axis from this frequency shift.
